# Widget device opening and URL handling (2026-01-06 16:18Z)

_**User (2026-01-07 18:48Z)**_

when the user taps the widget it currently does not open the correct device (only the app opens). The app should open and it should open up the map with the specific device from the widget.

It is important that there already is a functionality that triggers the "add device" functionality when the miataru://$deviceid URL is used. This needs to stay - when the device-id is not already in the devices list it should keep opening up the "add device" dialogue.

When the device handed over through the miataru:// URL it should open the map with that specific device

                .tabItem {
                    Label("devices", systemImage: "iphone.gen3.badge.location")

                .tag(0)
            iPhone_GroupsView()
                .tabItem {
                    Label("groups", systemImage: "person.3")
                }
                .tag(1)
            iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()
                .tabItem {
                    Label("qr", systemImage: "qrcode")
                }
                .tag(2)

                    Label("settings", systemImage: "gear")
                }
                .tag(3)

        .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)
        .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)
        .bottomAccessory(onTap: nil)

            #if DEBUG
            // Keep tab switching predictable during debugging and previews.
            #endif
            if newValue != nil {
                selectedTab = 0
            }
        }
    }
}
